quranTranslation.text: O ye who believe! Fasting is prescribed for you, even as it was prescribed for those before you, that ye may ward off (evil);

explanation.bs: „Propisan vam je post (الصِّيَام) kao što je bio propisan onima prije vas“ – temeljni ajet o postu.
explanation.en: “Fasting (الصِّيَام) is prescribed for you, even as it was prescribed for those before you” — the founding ayah of the fast.

quranTranslation.text: It is made lawful for you to go in unto your wives on the night of the fast. They are raiment for you and ye are raiment for them. Allah is Aware that ye were deceiving yourselves in this respect and He hath turned in mercy toward you and relieved you. So hold intercourse with them and seek that which Allah hath ordained for you, and eat and drink until the white thread becometh distinct to you from the black thread of the dawn. Then strictly observe the fast till nightfall and touch them not, but be at your devotions in the mosques. These are the limits imposed by Allah, so approach them not. Thus Allah expoundeth His revelation to mankind that they may ward off (evil).

explanation.bs: „Dozvoljeno vam je da u noći posta prilazite svojim ženama…“ – propisi o postu i noći.
explanation.en: “It is made lawful for you to go in unto your wives on the night of the fast…” — the rulings of the fast and its nights.

quranTranslation.text: And he who findeth not (the wherewithal), let him fast for two successive months before they touch one another; and for him who is unable to do so (the penance is) the feeding of sixty needy ones. This, that ye may put trust in Allah and His messenger. Such are the limits (imposed by Allah); and for disbelievers is a painful doom.

explanation.bs: „…onda post dva uzastopna mjeseca“ – post kao iskup.
explanation.en: “Let him fast for two successive months” — fasting as expiation.

quranTranslation.text: So eat and drink and be consoled. And if thou meetest any mortal, say: Lo! I have vowed a fast unto the Beneficent, and may not speak this day to any mortal.

explanation.bs: „Ja sam Milostivom zavjetovala suzdržavanje (صَوْمًا), pa danas ni sa kim od ljudi neću razgovarati“ – suzdržavanje od govora.
explanation.en: “Lo! I have vowed a fast (صَوْمًا) unto the Beneficent, and may not speak this day to any mortal” — holding back from speech.

quranTranslation.text: (Fast) a certain number of days; and (for) him who is sick among you, or on a journey, (the same) number of other days; and for those who can afford it there is a ransom: the feeding of a man in need - but whoso doeth good of his own accord, it is better for him: and that ye fast is better for you if ye did but know -

explanation.bs: „A bolje vam je da postite (تَصُومُوا)“ – glagol u propisima o postu.
explanation.en: “And that ye fast (تَصُومُوا) is better for you” — the verb within the rulings of the fast.

quranTranslation.text: The month of Ramadan in which was revealed the Qur'an, a guidance for mankind, and clear proofs of the guidance, and the Criterion (of right and wrong). And whosoever of you is present, let him fast the month, and whosoever of you is sick or on a journey, (let him fast the same) number of other days. Allah desireth for you ease; He desireth not hardship for you; and (He desireth) that ye should complete the period, and that ye should magnify Allah for having guided you, and that peradventure ye may be thankful.

explanation.bs: „Pa ko od vas bude prisutan u tom mjesecu, neka ga posti“ – zapovijed ramazanskog posta.
explanation.en: “Whosoever of you is present, let him fast the month” — the command of the Ramadan fast.

quranTranslation.text: The (faithful) slaves of the Beneficent are they who walk upon the earth modestly, and when the foolish ones address them answer: Peace;

explanation.bs: Robovi Milostivog su oni „koji po zemlji hodaju smjerno“ – način hoda kao vrlina.
explanation.en: The servants of the Beneficent are they “who walk upon the earth modestly” — the manner of walking as a virtue.

quranTranslation.text: And walk not in the earth exultant. Lo! thou canst not rend the earth, nor canst thou stretch to the height of the hills.

explanation.bs: „I ne hodaj po zemlji obijesno“ – način hoda kao porok.
explanation.en: “And walk not in the earth exultant” — the manner of walking as a vice.

quranTranslation.text: Then there came unto him one of the two women, walking shyly. She said: Lo! my father biddeth thee, that he may reward thee with a payment for that thou didst water (the flock) for us. Then, when he came unto him and told him the (whole) story, he said: Fear not! Thou hast escaped from the wrongdoing folk.

explanation.bs: „Pa mu dođe jedna od njih dvije, hodajući stidljivo“ – hod koji pokazuje ćud.
explanation.en: “Then there came unto him one of the two women, walking shyly” — a gait that shows character.

quranTranslation.text: Say (unto the disbelievers): Travel in the land, and see the nature of the consequence for the rejecters!

explanation.bs: „Putujte zemljom, pa onda pogledajte kako su završili oni što su poricali“ – putovanje radi pouke.
explanation.en: “Travel in the land, and see the nature of the consequence for the rejecters!” — travel for a lesson.

quranTranslation.text: Then, when Moses had fulfilled the term, and was travelling with his housefolk, he saw in the distance a fire and said unto his housefolk: Bide ye (here). Lo! I see in the distance a fire; peradventure I shall bring you tidings thence, or a brand from the fire that ye may warm yourselves.

explanation.bs: Musa je, nakon isteka roka, „putovao sa svojom porodicom“ – dugo putovanje.
explanation.en: Moses, after the term ended, “was travelling with his housefolk” — a long journey.

quranTranslation.text: And the mountains move away with (awful) movement,

explanation.bs: „I planine će se silno pokrenuti“ – سَارَ i za kretanje planina na Sudnjem danu.
explanation.en: “And the mountains move away with (awful) movement” — سَارَ also for the moving of mountains on the Last Day.

quranTranslation.text: And there came from the uttermost part of the city a man running. He cried: O my people! Follow those who have been sent!

explanation.bs: „I s najudaljenijeg kraja grada dođe jedan čovjek žureći (يَسْعَى)“ – brzi hod.
explanation.en: “And there came from the uttermost part of the city a man running (يَسْعَى)” — the quick walk.

quranTranslation.text: And that man hath only that for which he maketh effort,

explanation.bs: „I da čovjeku pripada samo ono za šta se trudio (مَا سَعَى)“ – trud, zalaganje.
explanation.en: “And that man hath only that for which he maketh effort” — effort, striving.

quranTranslation.text: O ye who believe! When the call is heard for the prayer of the day of congregation, haste unto remembrance of Allah and leave your trading. That is better for you if ye did but know.

explanation.bs: „…požurite ka spominjanju Allaha“ – većina mufesira: idite odmah i smireno, ne trčite.
explanation.en: “…haste unto remembrance of Allah” — most mufassirun: go promptly and calmly, not at a run.

quranTranslation.text: And in like manner We awakened them that they might question one another. A speaker from among them said: How long have ye tarried? They said: We have tarried a day or some part of a day, (Others) said: Your Lord best knoweth what ye have tarried. Now send one of you with this your silver coin unto the city, and let him see what food is purest there and bring you a supply thereof. Let him be courteous and let no man know of you.

explanation.bs: Stanovnici pećine: „neka razmotri koje je ondje jelo najčistije, pa neka vam od toga donese opskrbu (رِزْق)“ – prema ar-Rāġibu, hrana.
explanation.en: The people of the cave: “let him see what food is purest there and bring you a supply (رِزْق) thereof” — according to ar-Rāġib, food.

quranTranslation.text: They hear therein no idle talk, but only Peace; and therein they have food for morn and evening.

explanation.bs: „I u njemu će imati svoju opskrbu (رِزْق) ujutro i navečer“ – prema ar-Rāġibu, onosvjetski dar.
explanation.en: “And therein they have food (رِزْق) for morn and evening” — according to ar-Rāġib, the gift of the Hereafter.

quranTranslation.text: And in the heaven is your providence and that which ye are promised;

explanation.bs: „A na nebu je vaša opskrba (رِزْق)“ – kod ar-Rāġiba: ‚kaže se‘ da je to kiša.
explanation.en: “And in the heaven is your providence (رِزْق)” — in ar-Rāġib: ‘it was said’ that the rain is meant.

quranTranslation.text: He said: Go down (from hence), one of you a foe unto the other. There will be for you on earth a habitation and provision for a while.

explanation.bs: „Na Zemlji ćete imati boravište i uživanje (مَتَاع) do jednog vremena“ – prema ar-Rāġibu, svako ima uživanje u ovom svijetu za poznati rok.
explanation.en: “There will be for you on earth a habitation and provision [enjoyment] (مَتَاع) for a while” — according to ar-Rāġib, each person has an enjoyment in this world for a known span.

quranTranslation.text: Allah enlargeth livelihood for whom He will, and straiteneth (it for whom He will); and they rejoice in the life of the world, whereas the life of the world is but brief comfort as compared with the Hereafter.

explanation.bs: „A život na ovom svijetu prema ahiretu tek je prolazno uživanje (مَتَاع)“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Whereas the life of the world is but brief comfort (مَتَاع) as compared with the Hereafter” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And when they opened their belongings they discovered that their merchandise had been returned to them. They said: O our father! What (more) can we ask? Here is our merchandise returned to us. We shall get provision for our folk and guard our brother, and we shall have the extra measure of a camel (load). This (that we bring now) is a light measure.

explanation.bs: „I kad otvoriše svoj prtljag (مَتَاع), nađoše da im je roba vraćena“ – prema ar-Rāġibu, njihova hrana, a kaže se i njihove vreće.
explanation.en: “And when they opened their belongings (مَتَاع) they discovered that their merchandise had been returned to them” — according to ar-Rāġib, their food, or, it was said, their containers.
